Title: Large storage for Azure Database for PostgreSQL–Single is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL–Single now has support for up to 16 TB of storage and up to 20,000 IOPS. With this functionality, you get five times more storage for database servers, as well as more than triple the available IOPS. This ensures that you can run your most demanding, large scale workloads on Azure Database for PostgreSQL-Single server.

Learn more in the related service detail.
